scope: specification-only; all expected results are future acceptance criteria, not observed results

scenarios.action: single mode runs from start to settlement with all outbound requests observed
scenarios.expected: zero Firebase and operating Apps Script requests

scenarios.action: an emulator service is absent
scenarios.expected: fail closed without production fallback

scenarios.action: anonymous student attempts teacher session control
scenarios.expected: denied

scenarios.action: student reads another participant private response document
scenarios.expected: denied

scenarios.action: student writes score, aggregate, role or team directly
scenarios.expected: denied

scenarios.action: unrelated teacher tries to control an existing class session
scenarios.expected: denied

scenarios.action: same credential concurrently requests the same seat and operation id
scenarios.expected: one seat, one participant and stable replay response

scenarios.action: different credentials use the same display name
scenarios.expected: no automatic identity merge; require teacher decision or reject by policy

scenarios.action: join request races the session freeze transaction
scenarios.expected: serialized as included before freeze or explicitly rejected after freeze

scenarios.action: expired or revoked admission ticket is replayed
scenarios.expected: denied and no membership created

scenarios.action: temporary loss while original game tab remains alive
scenarios.expected: same identity and run; do not reset local timer or replay submitted actions

scenarios.action: reload or switch device after active run begins
scenarios.expected: no claim of restoring game state; teacher-mediated exception, excluded or fresh run

scenarios.action: older tab sends with a replaced connection epoch
scenarios.expected: reject stale epoch and retain one active connection

scenarios.action: offline queue reconnects after session closes
scenarios.expected: no implicit backdating or automatic late acceptance

scenarios.action: same run and idempotency key and identical result are submitted twice
scenarios.expected: one result and aggregate counted once; replay original receipt

scenarios.action: same run and key carry conflicting result payloads
scenarios.expected: conflict; preserve first committed result

scenarios.action: two submit attempts race session closure
scenarios.expected: transaction serialization determines acceptance; no partial or duplicate aggregate

scenarios.action: transaction callback retries following contention
scenarios.expected: no external side effects in callback and one final result

scenarios.action: client forges score or answer data
scenarios.expected: reject structural violations; mark remaining client-origin result unverified and never claim anti-cheat proof

scenarios.action: quiz, pause, death and Enter continue under class session
scenarios.expected: existing single-engine 600-second pause and continue semantics preserved

scenarios.action: late and out-of-order session events arrive
scenarios.expected: monotonic session revision prevents state rollback

scenarios.action: game or cartridge version differs from locked session
scenarios.expected: reject launch before gameplay

scenarios.action: existing phase 1 and 2 suite, trace, finish and QR tests
scenarios.expected: retain unchanged baseline and pass without weakening

scenarios.action: interactive board, physical keyboard, tablet, real sound and school network
scenarios.expected: separate future gate; NOT RUN until observed
